body.x: Viva Innovation (CEO: Park Han) announced its participation in CES 2024, taking place in Las Vegas from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday) local time.

The company aims to create a world where “good health can be managed with good doctors in good hospitals.” It has launched a health check platform that cares for the health journey pre and post-check-ups, currently serving 1.25 million users across over 280 hospitals nationwide. They possess medical device software that utilizes collected examination data through the digitalization of the medical system, enabling traceable observation based on health check results.

Specifically, they hold A.I. test design recommending examinations based on past health check results, A.I. symptom checks analyzing health conditions to suggest clinical departments, A.I. health prediction foreseeing health status by utilizing examination data and artificial intelligence per body part, and the Check-upGPT technology. This generative medical A.I. service learns dialogues during medical and examination extensive data processes.

The product showcased at CES is ‘KINDOC,’ a digital medical solution based on artificial intelligence (A.I.) technology by Viva Innovation. It comprises a mobile application, ‘Homedoctor,’ for users, a ‘Healthcare Coach’ for health management coaching, and a ‘Monitoring’ web platform for medical professionals. This enables personalized healthcare services for patients and supports diagnostic and treatment activities in clinical settings for medical professionals.

Through Bluetooth or wired connection to a server, KINDOC integrates various household medical devices and life-log data, hospital electronic medical record (EMR) data, and medical big data from public agencies to comprehensively collect individual health records, prescription records, and professional medical data.

body.x: A representative from Viva Innovation stated, “We initially launched the ‘Find a Hospital’ service after receiving medical big data from institutions like the Health Insurance Review & Assessment Service. After pivoting to a service finding examination centers within hospitals for business model exploration, we have grown into Korea’s number one health check platform by providing examination reservation and result inquiry services.”

They have since developed differentiated A.I. technology utilizing accumulated individual medical examination data and conducted advanced research and development. They emphasized, “Collaborating with university hospitals, we developed distinctive patented technology and A.I. algorithms to secure competitiveness. We utilized hospitals as remote monitoring testbeds, conducting service verification through clinical trials.”

They continued, “We have established systems in affiliated hospitals to obtain extensive comprehensive examination data stored only in hospitals, securing examination data about four times more precise than competitors’ data for analysis and development.”

The standout feature of the KINDOC solution is its ability to gather scattered personal medical data into one place, linking disconnected medical services into one platform. Viva Innovation developed technology to collect and integrate health check data such as past hospital diagnostic records, pharmacy prescription records, and health examination data like MRI, CT scans, and ultrasounds. Moreover, it can sync with home medical devices like blood pressure monitors, blood glucose monitors, body composition analyzers, and patch-type electrocardiograms, displaying current health status in real-time. Leveraging this data, KINDOC integrates three A.I. services within its platform. ‘Home Doctor’ and ‘Healthcare Coach’ allow users easy access to their health data anywhere, offering expert consultations based on A.I. analysis. Meanwhile, ‘Monitoring’ facilitates medical professionals in checking comprehensive medical and examination records, enabling real-time remote video consultations to support doctors’ diagnoses and treatment processes at clinical sites.

In 2020, Viva Innovation successfully conducted remote monitoring verification for 50 Mongolian patients through e-Hospital (non-face-to-face medical services) in collaboration with the State Central Third Hospital of Mongolia. In 2021, they completed ICT-based pre-consultation and post-care non-face-to-face remote collaboration services for 200 patients at Do Life Hospital in Vietnam. This allowed them to accumulate expertise in adapting and enhancing services to local circumstances, integrating automatic language translation within the platform.

body.x: LG Electronics collaborated with Viva Innovation from 2021 to 2022, dispatching residents to eight countries, including Australia, Dubai, India, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, Taiwan, and Vietnam, to conduct non-face-to-face health consultations based on medical data. A spokesperson stated, “We confirmed that overseas residents could not receive proper medical services due to language barriers and blind spots in local medical services. We can provide B2B medical welfare services for our country’s overseas workers and vice versa, conducting remote health consultations with local medical professionals for overseas workers of foreign companies.”

They outlined future business plans: “We aim for the mid-to-long-term realization of a health care medical platform linked with remote monitoring software, providing remote monitoring services based on examination results. Furthermore, we plan to connect individuals (B2C) and businesses (B2B) to health check hospitals and aim to scale up to a health check big data platform based on personalized examination data.” They added, “We plan to expand from the existing health check reservation agency service to traceable observation services based on examination results and elevate it to a brokerage service utilizing examination data. Through this, we aim to lead innovation in the health check value chain.”
